name: Ulf Holmberg
abstract_title: Entropy and Market Sentiment Revisited: A Preregistered Out-of-Sample Confirmation of the Global Consciousness Project–VIX Link
abstract: This study presents results from a preregistered empirical follow-up paper, examining the link between entropy fluctuations in the Global Consciousness Project (GCP) random number generator (RNG) network and financial market behavior. notable: PhD in Economics; published in Journal of Economic Studies (2024)
notes: Swedish economist who transitioned to consciousness research.
